card.name: Linking word after a heading noun
card.fires_on: Small linking words like 'of' and 'in' right after a noun in a title or table heading, such as 'Healing of' or 'Tumor Promotion in'. The next word is usually a capitalized term.

modes.label: 'of' after Healing
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'Healing' in dosage tables, before a condition like EE or duodenal ulcers.
modes.example: Duration Healing<< of>> EE 12 years to 1

modes.label: 'in' after a heading noun
modes.description: The word 'in' after a title or warning heading noun, before a group or subject.
modes.example: Tumor Promotion<< in>> BRAF Wild-type Tumors :

modes.label: Partway through Posterior
modes.description: The ending 'erior' inside the word Posterior in a figure caption.
modes.example: Placement of CERVIDIL in the Post<<erior>> Vaginal Fornix Tuck

card.writes: It seems to favor capitalized noun starts such as Gen, Skin and Liver, and to disfavor Power and Tech.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that links a capitalized heading to the subject that follows.
